answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch opens fixed agent slots; applicants bid a deposit at the wharf, top bids win, losers refunded minus a fee. A genuine agent bids once and earns it back in 10 days. A farmer needs 100 winning bids for 100 fakes, each outbidding real agents; at a clearing bid of 20 days of earnings, 100 fakes cost 2,000 days upfront. The delta between one deposit and 100 winning bids is a costly signal.
